tax.text: She says she would close corporate tax loopholes and require billionaires to pay more.
tax.quote: Close corporate taxation loopholes and ensure billionaires pay their fair share.

wages.text: She supports raising the federal minimum wage, indexing it to inflation, and protecting workers’ rights to organize and bargain.
wages.quote: Increase the federal minimum wage to $15/hour, tie it to inflation and eliminate the lower minimum wage that exists for tipped workers.

trade.text: She voted for a resolution terminating the national emergency used for tariffs on Canadian imports.
trade.quote: RELATING TO A NATIONAL EMERGENCY BY THE PRESIDENT ON FEBRUARY 1, 2025

debt.text: She opposes attempts to privatize or roll back Social Security and Medicare.
debt.quote: Fight back any attempt to privatize or roll back Social Security or Medicare.

housing.text: She supports investments in affordable housing and policies to boost housing production.
housing.quote: This year, I also helped lead the passage of another $376 million housing package which will fund homeless shelters, support renters, build critical infrastructure, and boost housing production.

schools.text: She supports increased funding for public schools and public education programs.
schools.quote: I would never have gotten where I am today without a high-quality public education system and affordable higher education.

safety.text: She favors criminal-justice reform that prioritizes treatment and invests in mental and behavioral-health resources.
safety.quote: Advocate for comprehensive criminal justice reform, prioritizing effective treatment over punishment.

immigration.text: She supports expanding DACA and creating a pathway to citizenship for immigrants.
immigration.quote: We must build an immigration system that guarantees dignity, one that protects and expands DACA and provides a clear pathway to citizenship for hardworking, law-abiding immigrants.

guns.text: She supports expanding background checks, investing in red flag laws, and reinstating the federal assault weapons ban.
guns.quote: Expand federal background checks to prevent prohibited individuals from purchasing guns without adequate scrutiny.

abortion.text: She supports protecting nationwide access to abortion and reproductive health care.
abortion.quote: Protect access to abortion and reproductive healthcare across our nation through legislative action.

gender.text: She voted against the Protection of Women and Girls in Sports Act, which would have imposed sex-based restrictions on school sports participation.
gender.quote: Protection of Women and Girls in Sports Act

health.text: She supports working toward a single-payer health system and expanding Medicare coverage.
health.quote: We must work toward the goal of adopting a single-payer model, and it must include comprehensive behavioral health, vision, dental, and prescription drug coverage.

energy.text: She supports transitioning to renewable energy and reducing greenhouse gas emissions.
energy.quote: I will champion a swift transition to 100% renewable energy sources to eliminate our reliance on fossil fuels.

voting.text: She supports counting timely postmarked ballots and expanding nationwide voting by mail.
voting.quote: I also worked to ensure ballots postmarked prior to the end of an election were counted.
